phi ~ 60 degrees. (Helix phi is ~ -60, strand is ~ -120, coil varies. Wait, sign depends on cross product direction. If cos is positive, it could be +60 or -60. Usually phi for helix is -57, strand is -119. Let's assume magnitude ~60 implies helix.)

cos(psi) = -2.739 / (2.098*1.835) = -2.739 / 3.85 = -0.711
psi ~ -135 degrees or +135. Strand psi is ~135, helix is ~ -47.
